This happens automatically and can be wrong. ‘No report yet’ refers to the sources that were reachable in the last 72 hours; headlines in Tigrinya, Amharic or Arabic are not matched.

Found automatically through shared words. They may support the claim, refute it or only mention it; they only affect the rating after review.

en.Wo eine Seite fehlt, kann Semay sie nich: Where a side is missing, Semay cannot show it. If it is missing from a story, that does not mean it is silent. We look for freely accessible sources and do not bypass blocks.
en.Jede Quelle ist nach Art eingeordnet, da: Every source is classified by type so you can weigh reports. The colour stands for that type in all lists.
en.Gestört; bisher nie erreichbar: Not working; never reachable so far
en.Abgefragt {ago}; neueste Meldung zu unse: Checked {ago}; latest report on our regions: {date}
The same rules apply to every side. Where we cannot see anything, we say so.
en.Meldungen: die Schlagzeile, ein Link zum: Reports: the headline, a link to the original and who published it. We do not copy articles. A report is not a verified fact.
en.Schlagzeilen in Englisch, Amharisch, Tig: Semay machine-translates headlines in other languages, such as Amharic, Tigrinya or Arabic, into English (MyMemory). The original is always shown with the report; the translation may contain errors.
en.„Auf einen Blick“ auf der Lage entsteht: ‘At a glance’ on the Situation page is built from figures and reports using fixed rules, without AI and without judgement. Every sentence names its source.
en.Geschichten: Nennen mehrere Medien in äh: Stories: when several outlets report the same thing in similar words, Semay groups their reports automatically. This says nothing about whether it is true, only who is reporting it.
en.Messwerte: Messungen von Satelliten und: Measurements: readings from satellites and sensors. They show that something happened at a place and time, never who was behind it or why.
en.Satellitenbilder: Sentinel-2-Ausschnitte: Satellite images: Sentinel-2 sections with exact capture time, only with at most 3% cloud cover.
en.Zeiten sind Berliner Zeit (derzeit {tz}): Times are Berlin time (currently {tz}), except satellite capture times, which are in UTC.
en.Antwortet eine Messquelle drei Stunden l: If a measurement source does not respond for three hours, a dash (–) is shown instead of a zero; likewise when Semay loads only a selection and it contains nothing. Nothing is made up.
en.Wie eine Behauptung ihre Stufe bekommt: How a claim gets its rating
en.Zwei Quellen gelten nur als unabhängig,: Two sources only count as independent if they are different organisations. A Reuters report picked up by another outlet counts once.
en.Jede Änderung bleibt mit Datum, Notiz un: Every change stays in the history with date, note and sources. Corrected wording is marked ‘Corrected’.
en.In Eritrea gibt es fast keine unabhängig: There are almost no independent media in Eritrea. Most reports come from the government, the diaspora or abroad.
en.Kurze Rückgänge der Internetverbindung i: Short internet connectivity drops in Eritrea can go unnoticed; the measurement signal is weak.
en.Kleinere Erdbeben in dieser Region erfas: USGS records smaller earthquakes in this region only patchily.
en.Vorfälle auf See sind die, die UKMTO mel: Incidents at sea are those reported by UKMTO. Anything reported only by other navies or shipping companies may be missing.
en.Bei 10 m pro Pixel zeigen Satelliten gro: At 10 m per pixel, satellites show large buildings, ships and runways, not people or individual vehicles.
en.Wer eine Stufe oder einen Wortlaut für f: If you think a rating or wording is wrong, write to info@beles.app, ideally with evidence. Every claim has a ‘Report a correction’ button at the bottom for this.
en.Wir prüfen jede Meldung. Ändert sich dad: We check every submission. If anything changes as a result, it appears with the date in the claim’s history and in the list of corrections.
en.In der Originalsprache, wie von den Anbi: In the original language, as required by the providers.
en.Semay ist weder mit NASA, USGS, UKMTO, d: Semay is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA, USGS, UKMTO, the UK Ministry of Defence, Georgia Tech, Microsoft, ESA or the European Union.
